remarks:
Last opportunity in Juniper Townhomes! Don’t miss your chance to own the final brand-new townhome in Marrano’s desirable Lancaster community. This move-in ready Winston layout offers the convenience of a first-floor primary bedroom and the ease of maintenance-free living with exterior care handled by an association.

Enjoy an open-concept kitchen and family room, first-floor laundry with gas and electric hook-ups, an attached two-car garage, and a full basement providing plenty of storage or potential for additional living space. Upstairs, you’ll find a second bedroom and full bath, along with a spacious loft featuring a walk-in closet—ideal for a home office or creative space.

Designed with today’s most popular finishes, this home includes quartz countertops, white maple cabinetry, luxury vinyl plank flooring, and recessed lighting. Added bonus—condo status provides significant property tax savings, and Marrano’s Peace-of-Mind Warranty is included for worry-free ownership. Taxes are TBD.
